recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片滿布中至大型母細胞（核質比高、染色質細緻、細胞質少且嗜鹼性）；流式細胞儀示 CD34+、CD19+、CD10+ 的 B 淋巴母細胞；間期 FISH 顯示 BCL2-IGH 融合訊號，MYC 斷裂探針卻呈陰性，直到中期 FISH 以 MYC-IGH 雙融合探針才看到隱藏的 MYC 易位。
features: Panel A: marrow aspirate replaced by medium to large blasts with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin, occasional nucleoli and scant to moderate basophilic cytoplasm
No Auer rods or cytoplasmic granules; a residual neutrophil and red cells in background
Panel B: blast gate expressing CD34, HLA-DR, CD19 and CD10
Panel C: interphase BCL2-IGH dual-fusion FISH with 2 fusion signals (2F2G1R pattern) indicating t(14;18)
Panel D: MYC break-apart probe with intact fused signals (falsely negative)
Panel E: metaphase MYC-IGH dual-fusion FISH localizing fusion signals to der(8) and der(14)
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate is extensively replaced by medium to large blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, finely dispersed chromatin, inconspicuous to small nucleoli and scant basophilic, agranular cytoplasm. Flow cytometry shows the blasts to express CD34, HLA-DR, CD19 and CD10, consistent with B-lymphoblasts. Interphase FISH demonstrates IGH::BCL2 fusion, while the MYC break-apart probe shows no split signal; metaphase FISH with an MYC-IGH dual-fusion probe reveals a cryptic MYC-IGH translocation. Findings are consistent with B-lymphoblastic leukemia with concurrent MYC and BCL2 rearrangements, a high-risk genetic combination.

ddx.dx: High-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements (leukemic phase)
ddx.vs: HGBL cells are usually TdT-negative, CD34-negative mature B cells with surface light chain, whereas these blasts are CD34+/TdT+ with an IKZF1 deletion.
Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic, vacuolated cytoplasm, are sIg+/CD34-/TdT- and carry MYC rearrangement without BCL2 rearrangement.

ddx.dx: Transformed follicular lymphoma with blastoid morphology
ddx.vs: Transformed FL shows a prior or concurrent FL component and mature B-cell phenotype without CD34/TdT expression.
AML blasts may look identical but lack CD19/CD10/cCD79a and express myeloid markers such as CD13/CD33/CD117.

stain: Wright-Giemsa; flow; FISH: BCL2-IGH, MYC, MYC-IGH
